description:
Explain this tx: Base transaction decoded -- status, transfers, swaps, approvals, USD value. Returns: a decoded transaction: status (pending, confirmed, reverted or not_found), block, from and to, value and fee in ETH and USD (Chainlink ETH/USD), and its decoded logs -- ERC-20 and ERC-721 transfers with symbol, amount and USD where priced, approvals (unlimited flagged), WETH wraps and DEX swap events -- plus a one-line summary. Deterministic decoding of the receipt, no model; a mined answer is c

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_eth_reads_v1/base_tx_explain. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_eth_reads_v1__base_tx_explain
